name: tug-of-war
title: Tug of War
description: Diverging duel bars: two contenders split a 100% rope per row; the brighter side is the winner.
question: Who wins where, head to head?
whenToUse: Head-to-head comparison of exactly two entities across several arenas (benchmarks, markets, categories) where per-row winner and margin matter.
antiUse: Not for 3+ contenders, absolute magnitudes, or trends over time — the rope only shows the relative split per row.
props: left/right: {label, color?} (defaults seriesColor(0)/(1)); rows: {bench, leftValue, rightValue, date?}[]; footnote?
